tests.total.description: Total unit test count (vitest) — lowered: TasksPanel+taskMomentum features removed. Current: 3419 (improved +299 via journal UX batch).

designTokenCoverage.description: Count of real design tokens (excludes _placeholder) in src/design-tokens/tokens.json. Phase 0-A: 1 (canary color). Phase 0-B: 29 (1 color + 28 typography: 5 family + 9 scale + 4 weight + 5 leading + 5 tracking). Phase 2-B will add ~80 color tokens from src/index.css.

dtcgCompliant.description: W3C Design Token Community Group format compliance (0=not adopted, 1=adopted). Spec: https://design-tokens.github.io/community-group/format/ (2025-10-28). Value=1 since Phase 0-A — every token uses $value/$type/$description. Phase 0-B extended DTCG coverage to fontFamily (array form) and dimension ({value,unit}) types via custom Style Dictionary transforms.

styleDictionaryVersion.description: Style Dictionary major version. v4.x added native DTCG preprocessor support and async format registration. Build pipeline: tokens.json → src/generated/{tokens.css,tokens.ts}. Phase 0-B added custom transforms zen/fontFamily/dtcg-to-css and zen/dimension/dtcg-to-css.

typographySystemCompliance.description: Phase 0-B typography foundation in place (0=absent, 1=adopted). Adopted when: (a) src/styles/fonts.css with @font-face decls for Fraunces+Inter+Caveat, (b) tailwind.config.ts fontFamily extended with display/serif/body/hand/mono, (c) docs/typography-grammar.md documents 5 sacred moments + anti-patterns, (d) tokens.json has typography category (family+scale+weight+leading+tracking). Future phases will ratchet up by adding component adoption metric.

fontFaceCount.description: Self-hosted variable font families shipped via @fontsource-variable (OFL-1.1). Phase 0-B.1: Fraunces (display/serif, Latin), Literata (display/serif, Cyrillic companion), Inter (body/sans), Caveat (hand). 20 @font-face declarations total (4 Fraunces Latin+LatinExt × normal+italic; 4 Literata Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal+italic; 8 Inter Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal+italic; 4 Caveat Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt × normal only). Each increment here indicates a new font added — locale-specific (ja/ar/he) will raise this in a future phase.

cyrillicDisplayCoverage.description: Phase 0-B.1 — Cyrillic-capable variable display serif wired into the `display`/`serif` Tailwind slot via unicode-range @font-face (0=fallback to Georgia only, 1=Literata Variable owns Cyrillic range). Before: Fraunces Latin-only, Cyrillic fell to Georgia, degrading the editorial-revolution aesthetic for the primary Russian/Ukrainian user. After: Literata Variable (Google Books, opsz+wght, OFL-1.1) automatically selected per glyph by the browser's font-matching algorithm — no JS, no :lang() selectors. Future increment possibilities: locale-specific ja/ar/he display serifs (=2, =3...).

themeCount.description: Phase 0-C — count of opt-in themes available via data-theme attribute. paper (warm cream 12.4:1 AAA), ink (warm dark 14:1 AAA), oled (true black 18:1 AAA). Existing light/dark/dark.oled remain operational via legacy .dark class — this floor counts only the new data-theme family (src/styles/themes.css @layer theme). Phase 2 may flip paper to default and deprecate the legacy family.

contrastAAACoverage.description: Phase 0-C — count of themes where surface-vs-primary-text contrast is mathematically validated at WCAG AAA (≥7:1) via automated test (src/styles/themes.contrast.test.ts). 14 assertions cover main text, secondary text, UI borders (1.4.11 ≥3:1), and primary button text. OKLCH → OKLab → linear sRGB → WCAG luminance chain implemented inline with no external color library (zero dep cost).

paperThemeReady.description: Phase 0-C — Paper theme infrastructure readiness (0=absent, 1=opt-in available). Adopted when: (a) color.theme.paper tokens in DTCG OKLCH format, (b) src/styles/themes.css @layer theme maps --zen-* aliases, (c) Zustand themeStore with persist + prefers-color-scheme auto resolution, (d) inline SVG feTurbulence noise + warm vignette active on paper variant, (e) dev preview page gated by import.meta.env.DEV, (f) contrast test passing. Phase 2 will ratchet to value=2 once paper becomes default for new users and Settings Panel surfaces the switch.

inlineStyles.description: Inline style={{}} in .tsx files. Tolerance 3% (~10) for prettier reformat.

bundleSizeKB.description: Total JS bundle size in KB (dist/assets/*.js). Tolerance 0.5% (~24KB). +36KB from journal UX redesign batch: 12 new components. Phase 0-B typography added ~112 KB of woff2 font assets but ZERO JS growth (measured 4917 KB post-Phase-0-B vs 4917 pre — fonts are CSS-referenced, not JS-imported). Font assets live separately; JS bundle ratchet remains untouched.

npmOutdated.description: Outdated npm packages — CANARY ONLY (external dependency, not code-controlled). Floor=999 disables blocking. Actual count tracked as canary only.

overrides.reason: 8th color stop (RED) added to ValenceOrb spectrum — +1KB for genuine feature enhancement
9th color stop (Orange) + OKLAB preview bridge + smooth shape morphing in shader — +5KB for visual quality
Added 9th enforcement dimension (5% weight) to computeQualityScore — rebalanced 8 existing weights. Score 9.8 reflects enforcement ratio 5/30=16.7% scoring 8.3/10

npmOutdated depends on external npm registry state, not code changes. Ubuntu CI reports 80 while Windows reports 79 — non-deterministic. Moved to canary-only (floor=999 disables blocking). Root cause: external dependency metric cannot be a code quality floor.

Phase 0-A tokens infrastructure — 1 canary OKLCH token proves DTCG→Style Dictionary v4→PostCSS OKLCH→CSS fallback chain works end-to-end. Scaffolding for Phase 0-B (typography+space) and Phase 2-B (color migration from src/index.css HSL).

Phase 0-A adopted W3C Design Token Community Group format spec (2025-10-28). Every token uses $value/$type/$description. Supports both legacy string colors and structured {colorSpace, components} objects.
Phase 0-A installed Style Dictionary v4.4.0. v4 is the first major version with native DTCG preprocessor and async format registration — required for proper OKLCH colorSpace handling.

Phase 0-B typography — added 28 real tokens: 5 fontFamily (display, body, serif, hand, mono), 9 scale dimensions (xs..5xl), 4 fontWeight (regular/medium/semibold/bold), 5 leading numbers, 5 tracking dimensions. Validates Style Dictionary DTCG fontFamily + dimension transforms end-to-end (tokens.css now has --typography-* vars resolving to quoted stacks and rem/em values).

Phase 0-B adopted typography system foundation: self-hosted @fontsource-variable packages (Fraunces + Inter + Caveat, OFL-1.1), src/styles/fonts.css with 16 @font-face declarations across Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt subsets, tailwind.config.ts fontFamily extended with display/serif/body/hand/mono, docs/typography-grammar.md documenting 5 Sacred Moments + anti-patterns. One dogfood swap in JournalEntryEditor.tsx (Outfit → font-display) validates the pipeline renders Fraunces in production build.

Phase 0-B self-hosted 3 variable font families (Fraunces display/serif, Inter body/sans, Caveat hand). Total ~112 KB woff2 assets (Latin+LatinExt+Cyrillic+CyrillicExt where supported). Fraunces Latin-only in the npm package — Cyrillic text falls back to Georgia via stack, documented in typography-grammar.md §RTL & i18n safety.

Phase 0-C — paper theme core. Added 24 real color tokens under color.theme (paper + ink + oled, 8 roles each: surface, surface-muted, surface-card, ink, ink-muted, border, primary, primary-fg). All OKLCH structured $values. Mathematically validated to meet WCAG AAA contrast for text (≥7:1) and 1.4.11 for UI boundaries (≥3:1) via src/styles/themes.contrast.test.ts.

Phase 0-C — introduced 3 opt-in data-theme variants (paper/ink/oled) via src/styles/themes.css @layer theme. Non-disruptive Option A: existing shadcn HSL vars in :root untouched; new --zen-* aliases coexist. Zustand themeStore with persist + auto-resolve from prefers-color-scheme. Not auto-applied — reversible preview foundation for Phase 2.

Phase 0-C — all 3 new themes mathematically validated at WCAG AAA. Paper: surface vs ink ≈ 12.4:1. Ink: surface vs ink ≈ 14:1. OLED: surface vs ink ≈ 18:1. UI borders all meet 1.4.11 ≥3:1 (mathematically binary-searched for minimum L delta per theme). Inline WCAG formula avoids external color library dep.

Phase 0-C — paper theme infrastructure READY as opt-in preview. Wiring complete: tokens.json (24 OKLCH tokens), generated/tokens.css (--color-theme-*), styles/themes.css (@layer + data-theme selectors + inline SVG noise + warm vignette), stores/themeStore.ts (Zustand + persist + prefers-color-scheme auto), pages/__dev/ThemePreview.tsx (dev-only live switcher), styles/themes.contrast.test.ts (14 passing assertions). Phase 2 will ratchet to 2 when paper becomes default + surfaces in Settings Panel with full i18n.
